messages:
tj: Heads-up: PR #41289 is ready for review. Changeset: routing fallback + batch allocator tweak; touches KV eviction and auth header ordering. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/41289. Need runtime + platform + infra + security sign-off before this weekend deploy. Who can own the merge slot and run the canary?

infra-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit/integration). Staging e2e queued. :white_check_mark:

sophie: I’m OOO tomorrow, back Mon — I can do a runtime pass Monday morning. @michael @ashley any chance someone can cover before then?

michael: I can give a quick platform pass today. I’ll check the canary config and rollout policy; ETA ~2h. Low risk expected but want to confirm prefetch flags.

ashley: Security quick take: the auth header reorder looks fine from a cursory read but please add a short threat-model note in the PR (what changes and why safe). I can give formal LGTM after that. @sec-team-bot do we have a slot today?

sec-team-bot: SEC Queue: slot available today at 16:00 UTC. Please add checklist item 'auth header ordering' and tag the PR with label `sec-review`.

tj: Thanks — can michael own the merge if you can give greenlight by ~16:30 UTC? Plan: canary for 30m, rollback steps are listed in the PR description. Quick smoke command to run locally: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --pr 41289`

michael: I can own merge and monitor canary. @ryan can you watch infra metrics/logs for mem or latency spikes during the canary? I’ll coordinate rollback if needed.

ryan: Oncall today — I’ll watch the canary. Will set an alert for >70% of baseline p95 latency and memory above threshold. Ping me in #eng-sre if anything actionable.

sophie: Left a small runtime note in the PR about the KV cache TTL tweak and included a microbenchmark diff (no regressions locally).

tj: Perfect. I’ll add the threat-model note and tag `sec-review`. Target merge 17:00 UTC unless objections. :thumbsup:
